summary: Iter350 — Communications (Firebase OTP + Twilio voice/SMS) non-regression review. All feature flags correctly OFF (no creds), gating verified on backend HTTP layer; auth (email admin + driver phone) and frontend /login render unaffected; CallProvider WebSocket opens cleanly at app root without console errors. Backend: 7/7 new HTTP gating tests PASS + 5/5 existing iter350_comms tests PASS (12/12). Frontend: /login renders PhoneStep with email-login-btn present and otp-login-btn correctly ABSENT (firebaseConfigured() returns false). Admin email login (admin@superapp.com / SuperAdmin123!) → /admin dashboard fully renders (849 users, 50 drivers, 1040 rides KPIs, sidebar + God's View map). CallProvider mounted at App root successfully opens wss://.../api/ws/call_user_2859d02f6d02. Zero console errors during the whole flow.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/auth.py /firebase/verify-phone correctly enforces auth BEFORE checking firebase_enabled() — returns 401/403 (HTTPBearer auto_error) when no token, 503 only after authentication.
routes/auth.py /firebase/login & /firebase/verify-phone both raise 503 with French message 'Vérification Firebase non configurée' when flag off — clean gating, no info leak.
core/firebase_auth.firebase_enabled() lazy-evaluates credentials on first call — safe to import the route module even when secrets/firebase-admin.json is absent.

frontend src/pages/auth/login/PhoneStep.jsx only renders the otp-login-btn when `onOtp` prop is truthy; LoginPage passes `firebaseConfigured() ? ... : null` — verified hidden in DOM (not just css-hidden), correct gating.
frontend src/lib/firebase.js firebaseConfigured() guards getFirebaseAuth() so no firebase/app initialize call happens when env vars missing — no boot crash.
CallProvider at App root opens WS /api/ws/call_{userId} only after auth (user_id resolved client-side); WS frame received successfully (open->close pair seen) without surfacing errors to UI.
Existing auth flow uses httpOnly cookies via /api/auth/login (admin verified through GET /auth/me returning role:admin email:admin@superapp.com).
Driver phone login POST /api/auth/phone-login still returns 200 with token+user for +33644112233 — backwards compatible with the new Firebase-OTP path which is purely additive.
test_credentials: Admin admin@superapp.com / SuperAdmin123! (email login → /admin OK). Driver +33644112233 / Chauffeur2026! (phone-login OK).
seed_data_creation: None for HTTP tests. test_iter350_comms.py creates+cleans up ephemeral users/rides/call_sessions with `test_` prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://gojek-clone-41.preview.emergentagent.com. Tests: pytest backend/tests/test_iter350_gating_http.py (~1.3s, 7 passes) + backend/tests/test_iter350_comms.py (~0.4s, 5 passes). Gating endpoints: GET /api/auth/firebase/status → 200 {enabled:false}; POST /api/auth/firebase/verify-phone no-auth → 401, with-admin-auth → 503; POST /api/auth/firebase/login → 503; GET /api/calls/ride/{id}/status no-auth → 401. UI flow: open /login → click email-login-btn → /login/email → fill email-input/password-input → click email-login-submit-btn → /admin dashboard. CallProvider WS confirmed open at wss://.../api/ws/call_user_xxx after login. When Firebase creds are added later, the otp-login-btn should re-appear automatically (PhoneStep checks `onOtp` truthy).
rca of the issue: No issues. Gating is implemented at the right layers: backend returns proper HTTP status codes (401 unauth → 503 disabled) and frontend hides the OTP entry-point via firebaseConfigured() guard. Auth non-regression confirmed end-to-end.
